scenarios.name: Concentrated processor outage
scenarios.threat: Ransomware or prolonged outage at claims/payment intermediary
scenarios.residualNotes: Alternate submitters and cash buffers reduce impact; they rarely eliminate intermediary coupling.

scenarios.threat: Data exfiltration from intermediary holding claims data
scenarios.asset: Patient / member data entrusted to processor

tierRationale: Revenue-access and sensitive data both flow through a concentrated intermediary — classic FAIR-TAM materiality.
